name: questions.observability.baseline
description: Baseline questions for logs, metrics, tracing, alerting, and incident response maturity.

questions.text: Where are application logs aggregated and searched?
questions.rationale: Log aggregation maturity determines MTTD — the first minute of any incident response.

questions.text: Which metrics platform tracks service-level indicators?
questions.rationale: Metrics coverage tells us whether SLOs are achievable — or aspirational.
Tracing is indispensable for diagnosing latency and fan-out issues in distributed systems.

questions.text: How are alerts routed and who holds the pager?
questions.rationale: Clear on-call routing is the difference between a 15-minute incident and a multi-hour one.

questions.text: Do you have runbooks for the top failure modes?
questions.rationale: Runbook hygiene predicts both incident recovery time and on-boarding speed.
